title: The live UI bundle (ui/dist) is never refreshed after landings, so landed UI fixes stay invisible
outcome: Every landing that changes ui/ reaches the running host's served UI by a recorded, authorized procedure, so a landed UI fix is visible after a browser reload
acceptance: The live UI bundle (ui/dist) is never refreshed after landings, so landed UI fixes stay invisible is done

blockers.detail: Deploying ui/dist needs Greg's explicit word. No recorded word covers it (Engram::Fable #389, Engram::Advisor #140).
